why: RJ-P14 (photo/tone-controls PT-4), pending TC-6 (suiteui/tone-controls, #4953): named .jobs.pending.json so the harness skips it, since tone.set's run throws notBuilt until TC-6 builds ToneCommands' bodies, and the folder has no input yet (the harness needs one). It is renamed to sharpen-web.jobs.json when TC-6 lands, with input/soft-edge.png (2400 x 1600, a soft-edged subject against a flat sky) and expected/soft-edge-web.jpg. The job: image.resize to 1200 px wide, tone.set sharpenAmount 80 and sharpenRadius 0.8, then a JPEG export. The traps: the export differs from the canvas because the CPU path runs a different order; Sharpen also sharpens the flat sky (no threshold). The assertions: the exported edge contrast rises by at least 20% while a flat patch's variance stays within 1/255.
